reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: The worst-case rule for both ranges and approximate amounts lives in one function; schedule-template's own isbetween dispatch is removed in favour of the helper.

placement.why: Planning-amount logic stays in shared/schedules.ts; callers in server and desktop-client only pass their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its planning callers, tests and a release note are touched; the form-conversion calls in useScheduleEdit are rightly left alone.

maintainability.why: Single clear definition; the defaulted positional op parameter ahead of the inverse boolean means a new caller can silently forget the op and get exact-value planning.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning call sites route through getScheduledAmount with their op, including schedule-template which previously special-cased isbetween.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplication; the threshold comes from getApproxNumberThreshold.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, now taking the amount op, used by preview transactions, posting, updateActions, forecast, API, schedule templates and the UI balance/table views.
